Dilloway-Thomas House
Very poor condition due to fire; owned by the City of Boston; will be transferred to the Afro-American History Museum.
The Massachusetts Historical Commission has allocated $25,000 to the Boston Public Facilities Department, for restoration of the house; the Afro-American History Museum is making an effort to raise $185,000 to fully restore the house and use it as the Museum premises; part of the ongoing John Eliot Square renewal effort sponsored in part by the Roxbury Action Program.
